title: Incredible scent and looks gorgeous!
text: Incredible scent and looks gorgeous!. I haven't had a chance to try this but from the moment I opened it I loved it! Truly fantastic smells great and puts me in a good mood just picking it up I just cannot wait to try it out it looks amazing! I really truly appreciate the effort with how beautiful it looks exactly as the picture and hopefully it can help me while meditating as well ! Also it includes a small pamphlet just in case you are new to smudging as well very useful. Honestly love the flower petals detail as well! Super cute!

product_metadata.title: MAMA WUNDERBAR Sage Bundles* White Sage and Palo Santo * Handmade Smudge Kit * Floral Sage Sticks
features: Our 5-piece "POSITIVE ENERGY" sage smudge bundle includes all that you need to clear a space, body, and/or mind of negative energy as well as create a sacred space. This kit is useful for any of life's occasions and makes a beautiful and thoughtful gift as well.

SACRED & HEALING HERBS & WOOD: You will receive 3 locally harvested California White Sage smudge sticks covered with rose petals and 2 Palo Santo wood sticks from Peru. We also include a description of the properties of the California White Sage and 2 Palo Santo smudge sticks as well as smudging instructions and prayers.

HANDCRAFTED WITH ORGANIC & ETHICALLY HARVESTED INGREDIENTS: Wild-crafted white sage sticks from the hills of California where we are based, every part of this kit has been carefully selected and assembled as to not harm the environment.
SMUDGE KIT CREATED WITH POSITIVE INTENTION & ENERGY: Your sage stick smudge set is reiki'ed with positive words, meditation, and balancing tingsha bells.
